title: Complete House Work
description:
The work includes complete construction and development of a residential house, covering all civil, structural, and interior works. This includes construction of all rooms, living hall, kitchen, and bathrooms along with full interior finishing.

The scope covers modular kitchen installation, custom wardrobes, POP (false ceiling) work, lighting, electrical and plumbing installations, flooring, tiling, painting, doors and windows, fittings, and final detailing. The project was executed as a turnkey solution, delivering a fully completed and ready-to-use residence.

The project also involves structural works, electrical fittings, finishing, and final detailing to create a well-designed, functional, and aesthetically pleasing terrace space.

title: Complete villa
description:
The work includes complete construction of a residential villa along with all interior works. The scope covers civil construction, interior lighting, custom cabinets and wardrobes, a modern modular kitchen, and well-designed bathrooms with quality fittings.

It also includes electrical and plumbing installations, flooring, painting, false ceilings, doors and windows, and all finishing works. The project was executed to deliver a fully functional, modern, and comfortable living space with attention to quality and detail.
